{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify and keep only the latest sample for each patient (highest sample_seq)
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping the last
df_latest = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify the number of unique patients after deduplication
print("Number of unique patients after deduplication:", df_latest['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check the distribution of severity in the deduplicated dataset
severity_counts_dedup = df_latest['severity'].value_counts()
print("\nSeverity counts after deduplication:\n", severity_counts_dedup)

# Now, filter for patients with severe disease
severe_df = df_latest[df_latest['severity'] == 'severe']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print("Mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients (ng/mL):", mean_biomarker_severe)"}
